limitations: Recorded PP inputs at 1.2 m/s, six short segments of eight poses per horizon; no full lap or hardware acceptance
Timing includes make_plan plus JSON and runtime legacy guard, excludes separate audits, initialization, control and disk
Window overlap is fixed-site overlap only, not the fraction of all validation queries avoided
Extra sites expose missed margin violations and reduce coverage; not a passing replacement
No continuous-s bounds or interpolation, enforced deadline, candidate control, footprint or dynamic guarantee
evidence_compaction: Fixed runs retain timings, IDs, grid metadata and all independent audits; moving paths retain routes/reasons/attempt counts. Full measurements remain in hashed local raw reports.
